top_choice_rationale: Magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene (MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero, Bistritzer) pairs a specific quantitative prediction (the 2011 flat bands at a magic angle) with an unforeseen experimental discovery (correlated insulating and superconducting states, 2018), reproduced across many laboratories and platforms, with the twist angle as a directly measurable control parameter. The citation can be limited to flat bands and observed phases without claiming the pairing mechanism, and the three-name limit covers both the prediction and the key experiment. Maturity and credit to Cao, Fatemi and parallel moire work are real costs, so B012 (P001) is a close and acceptable second, ahead of the lattice clock (P003), whose attribution is cleanest but whose new-phenomenon reach is narrower; any award is preferred to no award.
